headline: I Call Gibbs takes care of The Dude Abides

games.headline: I Call Gibbs takes care of The Dude Abides
article: I Call Gibbs beat The Dude Abides 129.70 to 116.40 in Week 7, a solid win decided by 13.30 points.

I Call Gibbs put up 129.70 this week, 5.3 over their projected 124.4 and the highest score in the league. Tony Pollard carried them with 35.0 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 21.9 over his projection. Trey McBride (22.1) and Jaylen Warren (15.2) were the other big contributors.

The Dude Abides put up 116.40 this week, 6.4 under their projected 122.8. Kirk Cousins led the way with 23.6, and Bucky Irving added 23.5. That would have beaten most teams this week. The Dude Abides just ran into I Call Gibbs.
The letdown for The Dude Abides was Dominic Zvada, who managed 3.0 on a 9.9 projection.
The letdown for I Call Gibbs was Aaron Rodgers, who managed 14.6 on a 24.5 projection.
Here's the painful part for The Dude Abides: starting Omar Cooper Jr. (20.0) instead of Germie Bernard (4.2) would have produced 132.20 points, enough to win.
I Call Gibbs could have scored even more by starting Makai Lemon (16.2) instead of Courtland Sutton (6.0).
At quarterback, Kirk Cousins (23.6) outdueled Aaron Rodgers (14.6).
I Call Gibbs improves to 7-0 (1st place), winners of 7 straight. The Dude Abides drops to 3-4 (6th) and has now lost 3 in a row.
Next week, I Call Gibbs faces King Henry (3-4), who are coming off a 17.5-point loss to Ken.

Next week, The Dude Abides faces Stroud and Proud (5-2), who are coming off a 43.9-point win over * Go Buckeyes and have won 4 straight. The Dude Abides will be without Dominic Zvada (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.

games.headline: Ken takes care of King Henry
article: Ken beat King Henry 99.10 to 81.60 in Week 7, a solid win decided by 17.50 points.

Ken managed 99.10 this week, 10.1 under their projected 109.2. Bo Nix carried them with 34.3 points, over a third of the team's total, 15.2 over his projection. Christian McCaffrey (19.0) and Josh Jacobs (17.6) were the other big contributors.
King Henry managed 81.60 this week, 31.5 under their projected 113.1 and the 2nd-lowest score of the week. Geno Smith led the way with 29.0, and Puka Nacua added 17.8.
The letdown for King Henry was Derrick Henry, who managed 5.4 on a 17.5 projection.
The letdown for Ken was Xavier Worthy, who managed 2.6 on a 10.0 projection.

Here's the painful part for King Henry: starting Luther Burden III (21.7) instead of Jalen Coker (1.4) and Rams D/ST (3.0) instead of Titans D/ST (-1.0) would have produced 105.90 points, enough to win.
At quarterback, Bo Nix (34.3) outdueled Geno Smith (29.0).
Ken improves to 3-4 (8th place). King Henry drops to 3-4 (7th).

Next week, Ken faces Slim Shiesties (4-3), who are coming off a 38.9-point loss to K9 Unit. Ken will be without Christian McCaffrey, Christian Kirk and George Kittle (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.

Next week, King Henry faces I Call Gibbs (7-0), who are coming off a 13.3-point win over The Dude Abides and have won 7 straight. King Henry will be without Kendre Miller (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.

games.headline: Oops cruises past The Canberra Mob
article: Oops beat The Canberra Mob 116.60 to 90.80 in Week 7, a comfortable win decided by 25.80 points.
Drake Maye carried them with 31.6 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 7.3 over his projection. Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.7) and Ashton Jeanty (17.6) were the other big contributors.
The Canberra Mob managed 90.80 this week, 5.9 under their projected 96.7. CeeDee Lamb led the way with 21.9, and Kyler Murray added 15.9.
The letdown for The Canberra Mob was Matthew Golden, who managed 6.9 on a 14.4 projection.
The letdown for Oops was Aaron Jones Sr., who managed 3.1 on a 11.0 projection.
Not much The Canberra Mob could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (102.40) wouldn't have caught Oops.
Oops could have scored even more by starting Dameon Pierce (11.3) instead of Aaron Jones Sr. (3.1) and Rome Odunze (8.9) instead of DK Metcalf (6.6).
At quarterback, Drake Maye (31.6) outdueled Kyler Murray (15.9).
Oops improves to 4-3 (5th place). The Canberra Mob drops to 2-5 (10th).

Next week, Oops faces Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup (1-6), who are coming off a 32.9-point loss to Dena's Team 🏈 and have lost 5 straight. Oops will be without Malik Nabers (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.

Next week, The Canberra Mob faces * Go Buckeyes (1-6), who are coming off a 43.9-point loss to Stroud and Proud and have lost 4 straight. The Canberra Mob will be without Woody Marks and Ka'imi Fairbairn (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

games.headline: Dena's Team 🏈 flattens Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup
article: Dena's Team 🏈 beat Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup 116.90 to 84.00 in Week 7, a comfortable win decided by 32.90 points.

Dena's Team 🏈 put up 116.90 this week, the 3rd-highest score of the week. Zay Flowers carried them with 24.7 points, 12.7 over his projection. Javonte Williams (21.5) and Braelon Allen (16.4) were the other big contributors.
Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup managed 84.00 this week, 11.9 under their projected 95.9 and the 3rd-lowest score of the week. Dak Prescott led the way with 28.8, and Jonathan Taylor added 18.0.

The letdown for Dena's Team 🏈 was Brock Purdy, who managed 13.5 on a 24.4 projection. Dena's Team 🏈 might have a quarterback decision to make if Purdy doesn't figure it out: Tanner McKee is sitting right there on the bench.
Not much Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (84.00) wouldn't have caught Dena's Team 🏈.
At quarterback, Dak Prescott (28.8) outdueled Brock Purdy (13.5).

Going into Monday night, Dena's Team 🏈 led by 5.80, and Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup still had Dak Prescott to play. Dak Prescott (28.8) put in work, but Dena's Team 🏈's Javonte Williams (21.5), Saquon Barkley (14.1), Dallas Goedert (7.3) and Brandon Aubrey (13.0) more than answered.
Dena's Team 🏈 improves to 3-4 (9th place). Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup drops to 1-6 (11th) and has now lost 5 in a row.

Next week, Dena's Team 🏈 faces K9 Unit (6-1), who are coming off a 38.9-point win over Slim Shiesties and have won 5 straight. Dena's Team 🏈 will be without Brock Purdy and Texans D/ST (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.

Next week, Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup faces Oops (4-3), who are coming off a 25.8-point win over The Canberra Mob. Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup will be without Jaylin Noel (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

games.headline: Stroud and Proud flattens * Go Buckeyes
article: Stroud and Proud beat * Go Buckeyes 106.40 to 62.50 in Week 7, a beatdown decided by 43.90 points. This one was over early.

Stroud and Proud put up 106.40 this week, 7.7 under their projected 114.1. Jaxon Smith-Njigba carried them with 26.8 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 10.5 over his projection. Quinshon Judkins (22.9) and C.J. Stroud (20.4) were the other big contributors.
* Go Buckeyes managed 62.50 this week, 25.7 under their projected 88.2 and the lowest score in the league. Emanuel Wilson led the way with 18.0, and Drake London added 16.1.

The letdown for * Go Buckeyes was Bryce Young, who managed 9.9 on a 21.5 projection. * Go Buckeyes might have a quarterback decision to make if Young doesn't figure it out: Matthew Stafford is sitting right there on the bench (and scored 22.7 this week).
The letdown for Stroud and Proud was Garrett Wilson, who managed 3.6 on a 12.3 projection.
Not much * Go Buckeyes could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (82.60) wouldn't have caught Stroud and Proud.
Stroud and Proud could have scored even more by starting Cam Skattebo (18.6) instead of Garrett Wilson (3.6) and Kyle Pitts Sr. (10.7) instead of Sam LaPorta (2.3).
At quarterback, C.J. Stroud (20.4) outdueled Bryce Young (9.9).
Stroud and Proud improves to 5-2 (3rd place), winners of 4 straight. * Go Buckeyes drops to 1-6 (12th) and has now lost 4 in a row.

Next week, Stroud and Proud faces The Dude Abides (3-4), who are coming off a 13.3-point loss to I Call Gibbs and have lost 3 straight. Stroud and Proud will be without C.J. Stroud and Chris Olave (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.
Next week, * Go Buckeyes faces The Canberra Mob (2-5), who are coming off a 25.8-point loss to Oops.
